complete_examples.text: Step 5 The system response (̃u ∼N(μ̃퐮, σ̃퐮)) follows a Gaussian distribution with mathematical expectation (μ̃퐮) and variance (σ2 ̃퐮) in this model, its probability density function can be follow as The variance of responses can be calculated as Based on the three-sigma rule for Gaussian distribution, the probability that the system response (̃u) will take a value in the interval range (μ̃퐮−3σ̃퐮, μ̃퐮+ 3σ̃퐮) is 99.74%, it is possible to demonstrate that the system responses are all within this range.

Meanwhile, Jarque–Bera tests on four typical time-domain responses under the assumption of 5% significance level (H = 0) are conducted, and the results show that all these samples obey the assumption of Gaussian distribution (H = 0) and the test values of P for the four typical responses are 0.5, 0.198, 0.5 and 0.5 respectively, which are all at relatively high values and can better indicate the reliability of the hypothesis.
Based on the probabilistic feature of wheel wear and Gaussian distribution hypothesis, the wheel profiles can be discretized, to establish a probability inversion mechanism for wheel profile points.
